name: Jean Hey
description: early Netherlandish painter of the Renaissance

summary.text: Jean Hey, now generally identified with the artist formerly known as the Master of Moulins, was an Early Netherlandish painter working in France and the Duchy of Burgundy, and associated with the court of the Dukes of Bourbon.

16038665: Nativity with a Portrait of Cardinal Jean Roulin is a 1480 oil on panel painting, previously attributed to the anonymous Master of Moulins, who is now thought to be Jean Hey. The cardinal was one of the Master's protectors and this is his earliest surviving work.
